body.p: Last updated: August 8, 2026
Atempo is a digital wellbeing application developed by Lumenfold. This Privacy Policy explains how Atempo handles information when you use the application.
Atempo uses Android's Usage Access permission to determine when selected applications are being used and to calculate the amount of time spent using them.
This information is used to provide features such as usage timers, session tracking, reminders, and usage statistics.
Atempo may process information such as:

ul.li: Usage statistics generated from those sessions

body.p: Atempo stores this information locally on your device for the purpose of providing digital wellbeing features.
Atempo may request permission to display content over other applications. This permission is used to show the optional floating usage timer while you use selected applications.
Atempo does not use this permission to read or modify the contents of other applications.
Atempo may use Google Firebase services such as Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics to understand application performance, usage patterns, and technical errors.
These services may collect technical information such as device information, application version, crash diagnostics, and anonymous usage information in accordance with Google's privacy practices.
Atempo does not sell your personal information.
Information may be processed by third-party infrastructure providers, such as Google Firebase, when required to provide analytics or crash reporting services.
Usage session information generated by Atempo is primarily stored locally on your device.
You can remove locally stored application data by clearing Atempo's data from Android settings or by uninstalling the application.

These permissions are used only to provide the application's digital wellbeing and usage awareness features.
Atempo is not specifically designed for children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
This Privacy Policy may be updated when Atempo introduces new functionality or changes how information is processed.
Updates will be published on this page.
